problem_statement.observed_failure: Private-repository GitHub-hosted Actions quota exhaustion caused ubuntu-latest jobs to fail before runner execution. A hosted reconciliation validation is currently required before the Lambda reconciliation controller will hydrate new project routes, so quota exhaustion indirectly blocked otherwise-free self-hosted research execution. Post-freeze runtime evidence also showed that a one-slot scale set can remain wedged after runner termination/controller restart when GitHub reports assigned-job state without complete per-job recovery metadata, and that routine controller/profile recovery still requires excessive operator sudo/shell access.
root_causes: Routine validation and reconciliation still depend on GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest.
High automation/PR churn multiplies short hosted jobs; per-job billing granularity makes many short jobs expensive in included-minute terms.
The reconciliation controller treats a successful trusted reconciliation workflow run as an authority prerequisite.
The existing project JIT controller admits only owner-commanded issue_comment PR-head jobs, so ordinary pull_request/push workflows cannot safely be moved by changing runs-on alone.

Admission-v2 currently uses statistics.TotalAssignedJobs as a scaling target while complete per-job metadata is required before a job may be re-attested and provisioned after restart; those two signals can diverge.
The permanent architecture did not freeze a bounded owner-restricted maintenance authority for controller restart and stale-assignment recovery.

invariants: Scientific and execution authority does not widen because hosted capacity is unavailable.
Dynamic runners never self-authorize the policy needed to create themselves.
Project workload runners remain ephemeral/JIT and fail closed on attestation mismatch.
Control workloads receive no GPU device access.
Control workloads cannot access operator home, Docker sockets, sibling project roots, provisioner state, reconciler state, or research trusted caches.
Project-specific Unix identities and filesystem isolation remain even if GitHub-side runner registration is centralized at organization scope.
Fork pull requests cannot execute privileged self-hosted workloads.
Repository labels, runner labels, and organization membership are routing metadata, not policy authority.
Concurrency is bounded; demand above capacity queues rather than scaling without an explicit policy change.

Under admission-v2, statistics.TotalAssignedJobs is a health/backlog signal only and can never by itself authorize JIT generation or root provisioning; a runner grant requires a complete independently attested job.
Ambiguous assigned-job state fails closed: the lane quarantines instead of provisioning from an unreconstructable count.

Recovery may delete/recreate only the exact quarantined scale set after local execution is proven quiescent; failure to prove a fresh scale-set identity and zero assigned state leaves the lane quarantined.
Privileged maintenance is a finite typed protocol, never an arbitrary root-command interface.
The dynamic L1 fleet is never the sole transport or authority for L1 recovery.

layers.purpose: Non-circular, minimal authority needed to validate/recover control-plane policy and perform narrowly bounded recovery.
layers.steady_state: Keep an independently installed bootstrap/reconciliation path plus an independently installed L0 maintenance controller/root maintenance socket. Neither depends on the dynamic L1 JIT fleet. Initially hosted reconciliation may remain as fallback until the stable L0 path is proven.
constraints: maintenance verbs are fixed and target identifiers are resolved from installed policy, never caller-supplied paths/unit names
root maintenance socket authenticates a dedicated unprivileged L0 maintenance UID via SO_PEERCRED
GitHub-side maintenance commands are owner-only and repository-scoped
durable replay-safe receipts for every mutating maintenance operation

constraints: assignment divergence enters fail-closed lane quarantine

phased_plan.objective: Create a self-hosted control lane without touching bootstrap authority, with stale-assignment recovery and bounded L0 maintenance implemented before live activation.
actions: Keep the exact workspace-control manifest blob efa6e09f4206ca1d1d2fe6daaabcb69ed01d4588 as MIGRATION_CANDIDATE_NOT_INSTALLED until implementation freeze.
Use an owner-only issue_comment pilot route so existing admission-v2 can attest exact same-repository PR head/workflow identity.

Implement the ASSIGNMENT_DIVERGENCE_QUARANTINED state and durable quarantine receipts.
Implement the independently installed L0 maintenance controller/root maintenance socket with only the frozen typed P1 verbs.
Implement RESET_STALE_ASSIGNMENT exactly as frozen: local quiescence, exact scale-set delete/recreate, two zero-state observations, recovery receipt, then READY_FOR_SINGLE_RETRY.
Keep maxRunners=1 and host/project concurrency=1 for P1; do not implement general resource-aware concurrency yet.
Create the dedicated workspace-control validation workflow with wc-admission-v1 claim and CPU-only resource contract/profile.

phased_plan.rollback: Stop/disable the workspace-control pilot controller and L0 maintenance endpoint if needed; retain existing hosted/bootstrap reconciliation and temporary known-good transport paths. Never remove the last independently recoverable bootstrap path in the same change.

resource_model.current_controller_limit: maxRunners=1 per project/lane remains mandatory for P1; it is a temporary capacity ceiling, not the stale-recovery mechanism.
resource_model.implication: P1 remains intentionally serialized. Assignment ambiguity is handled by quarantine/reset, not by increasing runner count.
resource_model.research_priority: Control lane must remain CPU-only and bounded so GPU/model work retains priority. Heavy dependency installs or full integration tests may queue but cannot consume GPUs.
resource_model.scale_policy: Any increase above one concurrent control runner or project manifest concurrency=1 requires a separately reviewed resource-aware host-arbitration design; maxRunners must not be raised as stale-assignment remediation.

immediate: Every review target is represented by exact Git commit/blob identities in a durable task capsule and PR.
Request GitHub-native review directly on the PR so later reviewers can consume comments without user copy/paste.
Where available, request GitHub Copilot code review automatically for design/code PRs as an additional reviewer, using repository/path review instructions.
A future ChatGPT reviewer starts from task ID and GitHub state; the user should not ferry review text.
review_automation.limitation: This chat cannot autonomously spawn a separate ChatGPT conversation. Copilot code review is useful for code/design review but does not automatically satisfy scientific independence requirements unless the governing task explicitly accepts that reviewer class.
future: Optional review-broker service/GitHub App that creates review jobs against exact blobs and persists signed dispositions; evaluate separately for model cost, credentials, and independence semantics.

Confirm admission-v2 can never generate/provision a runner from TotalAssignedJobs alone.
Confirm ambiguous assigned-job state quarantines fail-closed and cannot silently consume replacement triggers.

Confirm RESET_STALE_ASSIGNMENT has exact preconditions, exact scale-set target, local quiescence proof, fresh scale-set identity, two zero-state observations, durable receipt, and fail-closed failure semantics.

Confirm maintenance root protocol has only finite typed verbs, derives units/paths from installed policy, authenticates the fixed peer UID, and exposes no arbitrary shell/path/systemd/credential authority.
Confirm workspace-control pilot cannot access sibling project roots/control-plane state/operator home/Docker sockets/GPU devices.
Confirm P1 remains maxRunners=1 and concurrency=1; general resource-aware concurrency stays separately reviewed.
Confirm transport identity cannot widen execution resources.
Confirm automatic pull_request/push admission remains deferred to P2.
Confirm organization migration and GitHub App/runner-group changes remain deferred to P3.
Confirm temporary public visibility and GPU-listener transport are retained until reviewed replacements are live and rollback-safe.
Confirm review automation cannot self-approve authority-sensitive changes.
first_implementation_authority_if_review: After an independent NO_BLOCKING_FINDING on this exact v0.2 architecture plus manifest blob efa6e09f4206ca1d1d2fe6daaabcb69ed01d4588, implementation authority is limited to P1: admission-v2 stale-assignment quarantine/recovery, the bounded independently installed L0 maintenance path, and the owner-commanded workspace-control JIT CPU validation pilot. P2/P3/resource-aware concurrency/hosted-runner removal remain unauthorized.

p1_recovery_contract.purpose: Resolve BF-1 without widening runner capacity or trusting ambiguous GitHub assignment state.

admission_v2_scaling_rule.execution_authority: exact complete job metadata + existing GitHub attestation + deterministic admission identity + root provisioner admission
admission_v2_scaling_rule.forbidden: GenerateJitRunnerConfig or root provision request caused only by TotalAssignedJobs with no complete attested job

divergence_detection.condition: For admission-v2, GitHub statistics report TotalAssignedJobs greater than the number of locally active plus complete re-attested pending jobs, and the missing assignment cannot be reconstructed from complete JobAssigned metadata.
response: persist a controller quarantine receipt with project_id, lane, scale_set_id, observed TotalAssignedJobs, active/pending identities, last message/session identity when available, and timestamp
do not AcquireJobs for new work while quarantined
do not submit root provision requests
continue read-only observation so a later complete authoritative lifecycle message can resolve the ambiguity
divergence_detection.automatic_clear: Allowed only if complete authoritative metadata arrives and re-attests every assigned job needed to reconcile the statistic; otherwise explicit L0 recovery is required.

preconditions: exact project/lane is present in installed reviewed registry and is maintenance-allowlisted
controller has a durable ASSIGNMENT_DIVERGENCE_QUARANTINED receipt whose identifier is supplied exactly
root maintenance service stops only the derived controller instance for that project/lane
root proves no local active provisioner execution/systemd scope remains for the exact project/lane
L0 GitHub maintenance component proves there is no online or busy runner registration for the exact scale-set ID
the exact workflow route has no queued or in-progress replacement run intentionally created for recovery; if duplicates exist recovery remains blocked rather than creating another
reset_algorithm: remove any exact orphan JIT runner registration already identified by deterministic admission identity when safe
delete the exact quarantined GitHub runner scale set by numeric scale_set_id using the existing bounded runner-management credential
restart the exact derived controller instance; ensureScaleSet recreates the same reviewed scale-set name/configuration and yields a new scale_set_id

observe the recreated scale set until two consecutive statistics observations at least 15 seconds apart report TotalAssignedJobs=0 and TotalRunningJobs=0, with no locally active/pending admission state
persist a root/L0 recovery receipt binding old scale_set_id, new scale_set_id, installed policy digests, quarantine receipt, actor command identity, and the two zero-state observations
transition to READY_FOR_SINGLE_RETRY only after the receipt is complete
stale_assignment_reset.failure_semantics: Any failed precondition, GitHub API ambiguity, nonzero post-reset assignment/running state, local activity, identity mismatch, or receipt mismatch leaves the lane stopped/quarantined. No automatic retry job is created.
stale_assignment_reset.single_retry_rule: The recovery mechanism never creates a workflow run. After READY_FOR_SINGLE_RETRY, exactly one normal owner-commanded pilot trigger may be issued. Admission remains maxRunners=1 and the first acquired qualifying job consumes the recovery generation; additional recovery-trigger attempts wait or are rejected until that job reaches terminal state.
stale_assignment_reset.rollback: Disable/stop the workspace-control pilot controller and retain existing bootstrap/hosted paths. A failed reset never deletes the last bootstrap authority.

required_tests: restart with TotalAssignedJobs=1 and no complete JobAssigned metadata -> quarantine, zero JIT generation, zero root provision requests
late complete JobAssigned metadata that re-attests correctly -> safe reconstruction without reset
incomplete metadata remains ambiguous -> no autonomous provisioning
RESET_STALE_ASSIGNMENT rejects wrong project/lane, wrong quarantine receipt, active local execution, live/busy GitHub runner, or duplicate queued/in-progress recovery run
successful reset proves old scale-set deletion, new scale-set ID, two zero-state observations, and durable receipt before READY_FOR_SINGLE_RETRY
duplicate or replayed reset request is idempotent and cannot cause repeated destructive mutation
one replacement job is admitted only after READY_FOR_SINGLE_RETRY and existing exact admission checks still pass

maintenance_authority.purpose: Resolve BF-2 with a separately installed L0 control path that removes routine sudo/shell copy-paste without exposing arbitrary root execution.

topology.github_transport: An unprivileged, independently installed L0 maintenance controller polls a dedicated workspace-control maintenance command surface through the GitHub API. It does not execute repository code and does not require an L1 runner.
topology.root_boundary: A dedicated root maintenance daemon exposes a Unix socket owned by root and writable only by the fixed maintenance-controller group; SO_PEERCRED must match the installed L0 maintenance UID.
topology.independence: L0 maintenance controller/root daemon are installed and recoverable independently of the workspace-control dynamic JIT fleet.

github_command_contract.source: owner issue_comment on a dedicated control-plane maintenance issue or equivalently frozen owner-only command endpoint
github_command_contract.body_grammar: exact verb + project_id + lane + optional exact quarantine_receipt_id; no shell fragments, paths, unit names, environment values, URLs, or free-form command arguments
github_command_contract.replay_identity: GitHub comment id + actor + repository + exact parsed command + installed maintenance-policy generation

allowed_verbs.output: bounded status snapshot: controller active state, scale-set identity known to L0, local provisioner activity summary, quarantine/recovery receipt identities

allowed_verbs.targets: exact installed controller instance derived from project_id/lane
preconditions: actor/source command attested by L0 controller
operation does not modify registry, manifest, profiles, credentials, or scale-set identity
prove local provisioner execution for lane is absent before returning QUIESCED

explicitly_forbidden: caller-supplied systemd unit names or properties
arbitrary GitHub repository or scale-set targets
root_protocol.receipts: Every mutating request gets a root-owned replay-safe receipt containing request identity, actor/source identity, derived target, installed policy digests, precondition observations, exact mutations, result, and rollback state.

maintenance_authority.reviewed_policy_installation: P1 maintenance does not add a generic remote policy/profile installer. Exact reviewed registry/manifest/profile material continues to flow through the existing independently bootstrapped APPLY_PROJECT_REGISTRY reconciliation contract, which already forbids arbitrary commands/paths/systemd properties. Extending maintenance to install other material is later work requiring its own review.
maintenance_authority.github_scale_set_mutation: RESET_STALE_ASSIGNMENT is orchestrated by the L0 maintenance controller using the exact quarantined scale_set_id and existing runner-management credential only after root QUIESCE succeeds; it may call DeleteRunnerScaleSet on that exact ID and cannot select arbitrary repositories/groups/scale sets.
maintenance_authority.rollback: Disable the maintenance controller/socket and fall back to the existing operator/root bootstrap path. Existing reconciliation remains separately authoritative.

transport_execution_separation.invariant: GitHub listener/scale-set identity transports work; it does not grant CPU/GPU/root execution authority.
enforcement: root provisioner remains authoritative for project, workload class, execution contract, profile, devices, CPU, RAM, runtime, filesystem and network envelope
a CPU-only job transported by a GPU-named listener remains CPU-only if and only if root admission selects the CPU contract/profile and GPU count 0
P1 workspace-control route must bind only a CPU execution contract/profile with GPU count 0

host_resource_arbitration.p1_constraint: Keep maxRunners=1 and manifest concurrency=1; process-global provisioner serialization may remain during the pilot.
host_resource_arbitration.prohibition: Do not raise maxRunners or project concurrency to work around stale assignments or latency.
host_resource_arbitration.future_requirement: Before any concurrency increase, replace process-global count-only gating with reviewed resource-aware host arbitration accounting for CPU quota, MemoryHigh/MemoryMax, GPU device count/memory, runtime class, project/lane isolation, and research priority.
